contracts.behavior: Owner completes sign-in/MFA in a fresh Playwright browser; callback captured privately in memory for the same PKCE S256 flow, fixed public client and registered custom redirect.
One refresh attempt. Preserve refresh token and obtained time when replacement omitted; caller must persist rotation before later work.
Form-encoded GM exchange uses protected original device identity. Unverified GM token claims only check vehicle membership; missing membership returns vehicle-not-linked without discarding B2C grant.
POST bare GraphQL query as text/plain; charset=utf-8. Reject partial GraphQL errors. No JSON envelope is added.
One cached or wake digitaltwin read, exposing pending state only. Poll scheduling remains the future worker's responsibility.
Fixed healthstatus GET; selected typed diagnostic fields, explicit unknown freshness when a provider observation timestamp is absent; no automatic live probe.

Five pinned garage GraphQL read selections. Private identifiers and raw provider errors are excluded from snapshots. Only OnStar plan accepts explicitly labeled partial data; ambiguous command eligibility fails closed.

Exactly one fixed-v3 POST for start/cancelStart, lock/unlock door/trunk, alert/cancelAlert and flash/stopLights. Preserve pinned nested door/trunk request bodies; alert body is top-level. Remove safety overrides. Parameters and method/path/body/header assertions have synthetic coverage only.

Exactly one GET to a same-origin provider status reference. Explicit HTTPS port 443 on the exact configured host is canonicalized; other origins remain rejected. Accept nested or flat status envelopes; only explicit terminal status confirms success. Missing/unknown evidence remains outcome-unknown. Diagnostics disclose categories and presence flags, never provider identifiers or URLs.

intentionalDeviations: OAuth authorization and token URLs use the /oauth2/v2.0/ endpoints published by GM's discovery document. The discovery URL remains under /v2.0/.well-known/. Do not copy the stale fallback endpoints in upstream setupOpenIDClient; its normal path consumes discovered endpoints. TestPublishedOAuthEndpoints locks this distinction.

Owner-authorized Playwright capture handles the final redirect in memory; password/MFA entry remains manual. No evasion, password/TOTP collection, registry handler, traces/HAR/screenshots or automatic full reauthentication.
State is checked with constant-time comparison, has a ten-minute deadline, and is consumed once.

Identity is bound to sub from a signed enrollment ID token. Every B2C access token is verified against fixed-host JWKS, discovery issuer, exact client audience, RS256, expiry and prior subject; refreshed ID tokens, if present, must match. Compatibility of these stricter checks remains a live feasibility gate.
No refresh-token age is inferred from upstream's unsupported sixty-day fallback; provider rejection remains explicit.
Raw provider errors, tokens, VINs and coordinates never enter diagnostic output.

There are no transport retries, implicit credential deletion or v1 action fallback. The durable command service calls fixed-v3 transport with fresh owner checks, conditional dispatch, one-submission semantics and persistent kill switches. The user explicitly removed PIN requirements. New action routes require recent provider eligibility plus explicit owner enablement; source transport coverage does not imply vehicle support.

Read snapshots expose selected typed fields rather than raw provider payloads. They distinguish fetchedAt from provider observation time, bound response sizes, redact private identifiers and preserve unavailable/partial states. They do not infer coordinates, enable commands, or implement EV authentication.

Command POST and status GET have fifteen-second context deadlines. A submitted/pending response is never reported as success; malformed or ambiguous post-send results remain outcome-unknown. Provider HTTP 4xx is a terminal rejection and never triggers a second submission.

The attended helper writes a pending-verification seed before linkage and immediately persists a rotated refresh token before later requests. Failed linkage writes vehicle-not-linked and retains the grant.
The seed includes device_id_sha256 to bind import to the existing ONSTAR_DEVICE_ID, and provider_state to retain a failed or incomplete linkage result.

Persistent non-secret local metadata limits attended enrollment to two attempts and imposes a six-hour cooldown after auth endpoint HTTP 401 or 403, or a bounded HTTP 200 HTML Access Denied response. Vehicle endpoint denials do not trigger this global cooldown. A kernel-held nonblocking exclusive file lock is released on process exit; its pathname remains stable. The attempt budget is independent of ENROLLMENT_VERSION and is never reset by version changes.
